oracle_M.note: ceiling; not a real forward-pass selector, observes the M label directly

lookback_lens.note: 1 generation + 1 attention-capturing forward pass per query at eval time, on a SEPARATE eager-attention model instance; training cost (fit split) not counted per-query

icr_probe.note: 1 generation + 1 attention+hidden-state-capturing forward pass per query at eval time, on the SAME separate eager-attention model instance Lookback Lens uses; training cost (fit split) not counted per-query
